title: Maintaining Trap Seals to Prevent Sewer Gas Entry
description: A P-trap relies on a standing water seal to block dangerous and foul-smelling sewer gases from entering living spaces. Siphoning occurs when improper venting creates negative pressure, pulling the water seal out of the trap. In dry environments or infrequently used fixtures, trap seals can also evaporate over time. Professional plumbers prevent dry traps by ensuring every fixture is properly vented according to code, and by recommending trap primers for floor drains and seasonal lines. Maintaining the correct water seal depth keeps the drainage system safe, odor-free, and fully functional.
